# ref::<ref>, e.g. ref::cg::l01, so a lesson can be studied by tag (Custom Study, or the
# browser's tag tree). The tags are script-owned: removing a front here removes its tag.
# Columns: ref (<source>::<part>; cg = Complete Grammar, l01 = lesson 1), fronts
#   (space-separated card Fronts, exactly as in words.tsv/verbs.tsv/numbers.tsv/kanji files;
